items.name: basic laser cutter
items.description: A handheld fibre-laser cutter, about a kilowatt. Enough to slice through thin aluminium; steel will laugh at it.

items.name: hand lamp
items.description: A rubber-cased hand lamp on a wrist loop. Its cell still holds a charge, enough to light a few metres around you.

items.name: screwdriver
items.description: A ratcheting screwdriver with a fistful of bits in the handle. It will take most of the ship apart, given time.
